scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Those filthy little
creatures! Scurrying
around, snatching things
from me! If only they
weren't so blamed quick...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
那些肮脏的小东西！到处乱窜，从我这里抢东西！要是它们没那么快就好了……

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that the
Sweet Rice my son made?
Would you let me have it?
Please wait here a moment,
and I'll make you some pastry~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，那是我儿子做的糯米吗？能给我吗？请在这里稍等一下，我给你做些点心~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, where are all the
Rice Pouches? We need
them to make more rice cakes...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，米袋都去哪儿了？我们需要它们来做更多的年糕……

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Ooh, those white and
blue mouses might have
snatched my Rice Pouches
Those moles probably took
them too. Such nasty little
creatures, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
噢，那些白色和蓝色的老鼠可能抢走了我的米袋。那些波利可能也拿走了。真是些讨厌的小家伙，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that one of my
Rice Pouches? I'm sorry,
but the pain my hips..
Would you mind being
a dear, and delivering
that to my son for me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，那是我的一个米袋吗？抱歉，我的腰很痛……你能做个好人，帮我把它送给我儿子吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
It's not nearly enough
to repay you for what you've
done for me, but I'd like
you to have this pastry that
I just made. Please enjoy it~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
这远远不足以报答你为我所做的一切，但我希望你收下我刚做的这点心。请享用~

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Grandma]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊婆婆]

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, I was just making
some rice cakes and
pastries to celebrate
the new year, but these
animals have been stealing
the Rice Pouches I've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，我刚才正在做一些年糕和点心来庆祝新年，但是这些动物一直偷走我准备好的米袋。

scripts.text: Rice Pouches?
scripts.translation: 米袋？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Yes, my son needs those
Rice Pouches to pound the
rice in a mortar, but I can't
make any pastries if I don't
even have the rice. Do you
think you can help me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
是的，我儿子需要那些米袋在臼里捣米，但是如果我连米都没有，我就做不了任何点心。你觉得你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I don't even know you.
scripts.translation: 我甚至都不认识你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course.
What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。
我能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Well, do you think you
can catch the animals that
stole my Rice Pouches?
They're these blue and
white rats and these
nasty little moles.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
嗯，你觉得你能抓住偷走我米袋的动物吗？它们是那些蓝色和白色的老鼠，还有那些讨厌的小波利。

scripts.text: Not a problem.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not a problem.
I'll catch those animals,
and bring back any Rice
Pouches that I can find.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没问题。
我会抓住那些动物，并带回我能找到的任何米袋。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, thank you!
Good luck catching
those pests for me~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，谢谢你！祝你好运，帮我把那些害虫抓回来~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
I... Well...
That's true, but I was
planning on giving you
something nice in return
for your help. I know you're
not a bad person, so...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
我……嗯……
那是真的，但我正打算给你一些好东西作为回报，以感谢你的帮助。我知道你不是坏人，所以……

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Thank you for the
Sweet Rice! I'll be
sure to make something
delicious for you if you
bring me more, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
谢谢你的糯米！如果你再给我带一些来，我一定会为你做些美味的东西，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Breaks my heart...
My mom spends all this
time preparing rice for
the new year, and it's all
stolen by rats and vermin!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
真让人心碎……
我妈妈花了这么多时间为新年准备大米，结果全被老鼠和害虫偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
I hear from my mother
that you're helping her out.
She's a sweet old lady, huh?
If you find ang Rice Pouches,
you might want to have her
inspect them first.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
我听妈妈说你在帮她。她是个和蔼的老妇人，对吧？如果你找到任何米袋，你可能想先让她检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
If you bring me some
Rice Pouches, then I can
pound into into Sweet Rice.
You're here to help out my
mother, right? Thanks,
I really appreciate that.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
如果你给我带一些米袋来，我就可以把它们捣成糯米。你是来帮我母亲的，对吧？谢谢，我真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Oh, you brought me some
Rice Pouches from my mother?
Give me a second, and I'll
get this rice pounded into
paste, lickety split.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
哦，你给我带来了妈妈的一些米袋？给我一秒钟，我会立刻把这米捣成糊状。

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Man]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊的男子]

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Hoo! Haa! Hi-yah!
Woosha! Whoosha!
Ka-taaaaaaaaaa!
WOOOSHA!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
呼！哈！嘿呀！
呜沙！呜沙！
卡塔aaaaaa！
呜——沙！

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
All done. Here, this
Sweet Rice is ready to
be made into pastries
Would you please bring
this to my mother?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
完成了。给，这糯米已经准备好做成点心了。请你把这个带给我母亲好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but we
can't do any business if
you're carry so much stuff.
Would you mind storing some of
your things with the Kafra Service?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，抱歉，如果你携带太多东西，我们无法进行交易。你介意把一些物品存放在卡普拉服务那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I want to earn enough
money to buy that big
crescent silver pin.
I have to sell as much
of this Mojji as I can!
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我想赚足够的钱去买那个大的新月形银别针。我必须尽可能多地卖出这些Q弹的长条糕！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, hello! I'm selling
special rice cakes made
from sweet rice. You can
eat it yourself, or feed it
to your New Year Doll if
you have one as a pet.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，你好！我在卖用糯米制成的特制年糕。你可以自己吃，或者如果你有新年娃娃作为宠物，也可以喂给它吃。

scripts.text: [Lunar]
scripts.translation: [露娜]

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Anyway, I'm selling
10 Mojji for 3,000 zeny
Would you like to try some?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
总之，我卖10个Q弹的长条糕，价格是3,000泽尼。你想尝尝吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Thank you, and I hope you
have a happy new year!
Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
谢谢你，祝你新年快乐！欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny right now....
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，抱歉，但你现在的泽尼不够……

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, alright. Well, I'll
be here if you or your
friends want some Mojji
later, alight? Goodbye~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，好吧。如果你或你的朋友以后想要一些Q弹的长条糕，我会在这里，好吗？再见~
